newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FIRMER NEAR 1,780 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FIRMER NEAR 1,780 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed near 1,780 per dollar, firmer from the morning's 1,870-1,900 and 1,950-1,980 at Friday's close as dollar supply heavily topped demand on the interbank market, dealers said.
"The lev gained some 200 from Friday. The market was rather bearish on the dollar in anticipation of continuing lev rise," one dealer said.
The lev briefly tested new highs at 1,670-1,690 per dollar in early afternoon but fell back to 1,750-1,780 because lower dollar rates encouraged buying, dealers said.
Traders expected the lev to keep rising in the next few days stimulated by higher dollar supply.
"There is some interest for dollar buying near 1,650 and if dollar supply does not rise sharply I expect trade to consolidate between 1,600-1,700," another dealer said.
The lev has gained to its current levels from around 2,400 a week ago due to higher foreign currency supply. Markets were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
